reasoning: HSS4.4（outline 9.5.4）被 037 拆成兩個 sub-id：052-01 是編輯按鈕在行車中灰化且編輯畫面不可用，052-02 是按下後的攔截 popup。依 §8.2.1 各持有 TC。這兩者是同一觸發（行車中按下編輯按鈕）的連帶結果，若 037 未拆，依 §5.7 應併為一條；但 037 已拆 sub-id，§8.2.1 勝出（與 Profile §4 對 052-01/052-02 的明文一致）。車輛行進狀態是規格觸發條件，屬 §8.5 例外允許的 Pre-Condition。052-02 的 popup：規格寫「Feature not available while vehicle is in motion.」，但 Profile §3.4 明定 popup 文字取自 Pop Up List 而非規格書轉述。Pop Up List 中 PU0091（General，Driver Lockout: Function，控制項 <X>/<OK>，與規格描述的 [OK, X] 相符）為對應列，Arif done region 列 44/45 亦引用 PU0091。另一候選 PU0243 雖字面相符，但其 description 為「main category bar」的鎖定，屬不同功能且無退出條件，不採。Feature/Function 用字差異記入 A-H15。優先級：行車中鎖定屬駕駛分心防護，052-01 訂 P0；攔截 popup 為其回饋，訂 P1。

distinguishing_axis.delta: -01 the lockout itself (button greyed, edit screen unavailable); -02 the popup shown when the greyed button is pressed

tcs.test_item:
The system shall implement Shortcut Icon Lockout in Motion: Shortcut Layout edit screen is not available and button is greyed out while the vehicle is in motion.

(Vehicle in motion -> the Shortcuts widget edit button is greyed out and the Shortcuts Layout screen does not open)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. A Shortcuts widget is placed on a Home Screen page
3. At least two shortcuts are set in the Shortcuts widget
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that contains the Shortcuts widget
2. Read the state of the edit button on the Shortcuts widget
3. Set the vehicle speed above 0 (more than 8)
4. Read the state of the edit button on the Shortcuts widget
5. Select the edit button on the Shortcuts widget
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the Shortcuts widget is displayed
2. The edit button on the Shortcuts widget is displayed and available
3. The vehicle speed is set above 0 (more than 8)
4. The edit button on the Shortcuts widget is greyed out
5. The Shortcuts Layout screen is not displayed and the Home Screen page remains displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_9.5.4
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
"Feature not available while vehicle is in motion." [OK, X] shall close pop-up.

(Greyed edit button pressed while the vehicle is in motion -> the driver lockout popup is displayed and closes on either control)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle speed is 0
2. A Shortcuts widget is placed on a Home Screen page
3. At least two shortcuts are set in the Shortcuts widget
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Navigate to the Home Screen page that contains the Shortcuts widget
2. Set the vehicle speed above 0 (more than 8)
3. Select the greyed out edit button on the Shortcuts widget
4. Press <OK> on the popup
5. Select the greyed out edit button on the Shortcuts widget again
6. Press <X> on the popup
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Home Screen page with the Shortcuts widget is displayed
2. The vehicle speed is set above 0 (more than 8)
3. Popup PU0091 is displayed reading "Function not available while vehicle is in motion." with the <OK> and <X> controls, as defined by PU0091 String/Popup Message
4. Popup PU0091 is closed and the Home Screen page remains displayed
5. Popup PU0091 is displayed again
6. Popup PU0091 is closed and the Shortcuts Layout screen is not displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Home Screen HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 Post 2A (March 17 2023)_9.5.4
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.remarks: Popup wording follows PU0091 per Profile §3.4; the spec paraphrases it as "Feature ..." (A-H15)
